files.callability_and_semantics: Command main -> build_split. Accepts only fast backend and rejects the presence of model.num_ancs, even zero; sets num_ancs=0. Config keys max_*_rows rejected in favor of distinct-interval cap. Stores uncompressed ZIP64 NPZ with six arrays and metadata v2. Chunks default1024/stride512, labels-100/mask0 padding, width and previous-start genetic distances. Seeds control optional sample capping only, currently max_haps=None.

files.callability_and_semantics: Rust-public hidden constructor retains num_ancs and directly builds parent-chain ancestor nodes despite archive/full paths rejecting ancestors. Local LCA rebuilt each tree; all query-reference distances precomputed in uncapped u32, reference-reference values epoch cached. Shared selector applies drop-top augmentation. Matrix contains sample, selected refs, inferred ancestors then repeated sample-node padding; population tokens sample0/ancestor1/pad2, sorted cohort IDs>=3. Default log=true uses log2(1+distance), then floor/cap. Whole-tree batches can exceed requested max_rows or max_count; row cap is not exact scientific support. observations_requiring_primary_matrix_in: Fast linear u16 wrap before cap is a concrete source-native discrepancy, separate from default log mode; inactive patch owned by primary ARGMix reviewer.
Reference-index tie break plus HashMap reference order can change selected donor identities; group HashMap iteration changes chunk order even with a fixed sample cap seed.
Archive/full path ancestor rejection and surviving low-level ancestor support are different scientific contracts.
Optional ids_only merge preserves first matrix despite changed branch times; current selected recipe merge=false.
NPZ native label source supports first SNP/majority/purity with observed SNP filtering and sample joins; denominator is not same-site per-focal truth by default.
HDF5 stored features are fp16 bit patterns even if transferfp32; TSV truncates fractional coordinates.
Inference counters/text completion do not substitute for successful structured stats and finalized writer receipt.
Both crate lockfiles resolve different pyo3/tskit versions; pinned lock metadata does not prove an installed or paper-identical runtime.
